summary: Phase W — Platform Regression + Surface Hardening. Tested both backend (27 pytest cases) and frontend (RBAC matrix on 7 admin routes × 3 roles, modularization sanity, public/storefront/client surface contamination, cross-tenant isolation, adaptive onboarding regression). RESULT: route-guard hardening landed cleanly and the SectionRenderers modularization preserved all Phase U behaviour. RBAC matrix is 21/21 GREEN: designer@ redirected to /dashboard, client@ redirected to /client, demo@ (super_admin) stays on each of the 7 admin routes, with ZERO admin-shell flash on the denied roles ([data-testid=storefront-studio] count=0 on every redirect for designer + client). Modularization verified: SectionRenderers.jsx is 644 LOC (was ~1450), and the 4 renderer files + shared.js exist at /app/frontend/src/components/storefront/renderers/. On demo studio /settings/storefront the storefront shell mounts with all 7 sections, all 4 Phase U toolbar prefixes (stats-toolbar-*, mag-toolbar-*, brand-toolbar-*, team-toolbar-*) present and discoverable, plus 30 stat-* IDs, 27 mag-article-* IDs, 75 brand-* IDs, stats-accent-gold, mag-density-comfortable, brand-theme-auto, team-variant-warm chips — Phase U test IDs survived modularization. Public anonymous / renders cleanly with data-surface=storefront, 0 editor toolbars, 0 +Add buttons, and both '850' stats and 'Stefano' visible (CMS overrides resolve without editor chrome). studio2@ (different tenant — MOOD Demo Showroom) /settings/storefront mounts its OWN shell with 0 Phase U toolbars and ZERO 'Stefano' / 'mood-demo-studio' leakage. Client portal: data-surface=client, 0 admin widgets (pipeline/insights/os-widget all absent). Adaptive onboarding: office card on /start-project clickable (deeper step-2 assertion already covered by iteration_44). Backend: 27/27 pytest pass — every /api/storefront/admin/*, /api/client-messages/*, /api/human-assignment/*, /api/profile/me, /api/tenant-onboarding/* endpoint returns 401 anonymous AND with a fake bearer token; /api/onboarding/briefing-summary stays public; /api/storefront/public/* stays public; all 4 demo credentials log in successfully; studio2 admin storefront pages list does not contain Demo Studio tenant slug.

critical_code_review_comments: Modularization is well-executed: SectionRenderers.jsx dropped from ~1450 → 644 LOC, each block renderer is a self-contained file with a default export, shared primitives (BlockToolbar/ToolbarSegment/ToolbarChip/EditableImage/PILLAR_ICONS/getField/getSetting/FALLBACK_CHAIN) live in shared.js. App.js StudioAdminRoute is a clean 8-line guard that handles loading, unauthenticated, client redirect to /client, and any-other-role redirect to /dashboard — no admin shell mounts before the role check, which is exactly what the spec required.

StudioAdminRoute treats tenant_admin and super_admin identically (both allowed). That matches the spec; just flagging that any future granular distinction (e.g. plan page being super_admin only) would need a per-route role array instead of the single guard component.
TeamIdentityCardRenderer.jsx is 291 LOC — under the 700-line cap and well below the prior monolith. Good.
Public storefront leaks ZERO editor testids — the surface=storefront guard in the renderer tree correctly suppresses BlockToolbar children when not in /settings/storefront. Confirmed via DOM scan.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase W (route-guard hardening + SectionRenderers modularization) is fully verified. The reusable artefacts are: (1) /app/backend/tests/test_phase_w_regression.py — parametrised endpoint-protection suite, safe to re-run on every iteration; (2) the Playwright RBAC matrix pattern (login → goto each of the 7 /settings/* routes → assert page.url contains the expected redirect target AND [data-testid=storefront-studio] count=0). Carryovers worth eventually closing: (a) team_identity_card portrait initials fallback, (b) cosmetic console warnings. Neither blocks Phase W exit.
rca of the issue: No new bugs introduced in Phase W. Two pre-existing low-severity cosmetic items remain: (1) Team portrait shows browser broken-image icon when leader.portrait_url is empty — fix is a simple ternary in TeamIdentityCardRenderer that renders initials in a circular div when !portrait_url; (2) Empty warnings on /start-project step imagery — fix is to conditionally render the only when src is truthy.
